questions.stem: A player completes 15 quests. Each quest awards 19 gold coins. How much gold was earned in total?
questions.hint: Multiply by the ones digit first, then multiply by the tens digit with a placeholder zero.
questions.explanation: Multiply 19 by the ones digit 5: 19 × 5 = 95. Multiply 19 by the tens digit 1 (which is 10): 19 × 10 = 190. Add the two partial products together: 95 + 190 = 285.
